author: Ben Shapiro
description:
Titans on Tomorrow Ep. 4 with guest Clay Travis
Subscribe to The Clay Travis Show on Youtube: https://youtube.com/@theclaytravis

In January 2011, Clay Travis turned his phone back on after a meeting and learned his employer no longer existed. He had a three-year-old, a baby, and a $45,000-a-year radio job. Six months later, he launched OutKick from a hotel room as a one-man band, writing every article and selling every ad. Ten years later, Fox bought it for a reported $100 million.

Now he's launching a new sports media empire, in the age of AI.

In Episode 4 of Titans on Tomorrow, Ben Shapiro sits down with Clay Travis, founder of OutKick, co-host of The Clay Travis and Buck Sexton Show on more than 550 stations nationwide, and founder of the brand-new Sport & State, for a look at building a media business designed to win. Clay breaks down:

• Why he turned down a Fox TV deal to become the next Skip Bayless

• How one Super Bowl brought in $2 million in sports betting revenue

• Why
title: Fired With a Newborn to a $100 MILLION Sale to Fox - Clay Travis' Media Empire
